text: The Director, Housing Secretariat will give a presentation on Supporting Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Communities in Accessing Safe Affordable and Supportive Housing.

The Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Queer and Two-Spirit Advisory Committee: 1. Requested the Director, Housing Secretariat to incorporate the Committee's feedback into the Housing Secretariat's strategy for engaging with Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer communities.
